clue.text: Show sore distress about the rose son ruined

indicators.note: something ruined is wrecked out of shape, so the four words before it are rearranged into new order

explanation.surface: Someone is upset because a rose and a son have both come to grief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ruined' signals that the letters of ABOUT THE ROSE SON are rearranged; all fifteen are used.
explanation.definitionFit: To weep inconsolably is the idiom's meaning, which is a showing of great distress.

clue.text: Impulsive acquisition of fashionable riding-boot accessory

definitions.meaning: done on a sudden whim, without forethought
read literally: a spur (worn on a riding boot) that is the fashion of the moment

explanation.surface: A rider makes a hasty purchase of a trendy boot accessory.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes an unplanned, sudden decision; literally it is a spur that is currently in vogue.

clue.text: Let everyone in without exception

definitions.meaning: read literally: exclude (bar) nobody
the idiom meaning with no one left out

explanation.surface: A doorman is told to admit the whole crowd with no exceptions.
explanation.definitionFit: Barring nobody means admitting all; the idiom also means wholly, with not a single exclusion.

clue.text: Keeps criticising hacks

definitions.meaning: to keep finding fault with someone is to harass them verbally
hacks are old or worn-out horses

explanation.surface: Someone constantly finds fault with journalists.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep scolding is a verb sense; worn-out riding horses give the noun sense.

clue.text: Made a record-but clearly not in the tennis match!

definitions.meaning: to put something in writing is to record it

definitions.text: clearly not in the tennis match
definitions.meaning: a player trailing by a set in tennis is one set behind, plainly losing

explanation.surface: Someone notes it down, though not at a tennis match.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing something on paper is recording it; in tennis, being behind by one set is the trailing position.

clue.text: English polar explorer can hold one's attention

parts.note: James Clark Ross was a British explorer of both polar regions

explanation.surface: An English explorer of the poles is able to captivate an audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can' is a link joining wordplay and definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To absorb someone completely is to keep their attention fixed.

clue.text: Consider what the job pays

definitions.meaning: to regard or judge something
the ... for a job is its payment

explanation.surface: A worker weighs up what a post offers in wages.
explanation.definitionFit: To regard or judge is one sense; a level of pay or charge is the other.

clue.text: Iridescent ring given to companion in the East

parts.note: a ring is round, the shape of the letter O
a pal is a friend or companion
E is the abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A shimmering ring is presented to a friend in Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes the milky, shifting play of colours seen in opal, which is iridescence.

clue.text: Be resolved to travel with a powerful shipping company

definitions.meaning: to act firmly and decisively on a matter

definitions.text: to travel with a powerful shipping company
definitions.meaning: read literally: to sail on (take) a strong shipping line

explanation.surface: Someone is determined to voyage with a mighty shipping firm.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to adopt a firm stance; literally it is boarding a vessel of a big shipping line.

clue.text: Honest expression of Tory support

definitions.meaning: of upstanding, decent character
a cheer of 'Up (the) Right!', the Right being the Conservative side

explanation.surface: A frank Conservative voices support for the party.
explanation.definitionFit: A person of integrity is described with this adjective; split, it is a cheer for the political Right.

clue.text: Return home and recover

definitions.meaning: to arrive back at one's house
to regain something lost

explanation.surface: Someone comes back to their house and regains their strength.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming back is one sense; regaining possession of something is the other.

clue.text: Honour the bearer of old instrument

indicators.note: a bearer carries something, so the honour holds the other piece within it

parts.note: OBE is the Order of the British Empire, a British honour

explanation.surface: A decorated person carries an antique musical instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: OBE (Officer of the Order of the British Empire) is a British honour.
explanation.definitionFit: This double-reed woodwind is a musical instrument.

clue.text: A revolver unaffected by recoil

indicators.note: a word unchanged when sprung back the other way reads identically in both directions

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A handgun that does not kick back when fired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolver' suggests a gun and 'recoil' its kick; here a revolver is anything that spins, and recoil means reading backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The rotating part of a helicopter or engine is something that turns round and round.

clue.text: Pass is required to enter Victoria and Albert

indicators.note: entering means going inside, so one piece is put within the other

parts.note: V is short for Victoria
A is short for Albert, as in the V&A museum

explanation.surface: A ticket is needed to get into the Victoria and Albert Museum.
explanation.walkthrough: The V&A is London's Victoria and Albert Museum; its initials are cut open to take IS.
explanation.definitionFit: The travel document is a permit allowing entry to a country.

clue.text: Guide Ayesha into a city of Sumer

indicators.note: one piece goes into another, so it sits inside it

parts.note: Ur was an ancient city of Sumer in Mesopotamia
Ayesha is the title character of H Rider Haggard's novel She

explanation.surface: Someone leads a woman named Ayesha to an ancient Sumerian city.
explanation.definitionFit: An attendant who shows people to their seats is a guide.

clue.text: Signal to the French marines

parts.note: a la is French for 'to the'
RM stands for Royal Marines

explanation.surface: A signal is sent to the French marine troops.
explanation.definitionFit: A warning sound or bell is a signal of danger.

clue.text: Time to work out a capital charge

parts.note: to reason is to work something out by thinking

explanation.surface: Someone needs time to understand a serious criminal accusation.
explanation.definitionFit: Betraying one's country was a crime punishable by death, hence a capital offence.

clue.text: Sun, air and liquid

parts.note: Sol is the Latin name for the sun
to air an opinion is to vent it

explanation.surface: A list of elements: sunshine, fresh air and fluid.
explanation.definitionFit: A dissolving agent is a fluid in which other substances are dissolved.

clue.text: Typical measure by the media to expose a royal

parts.note: an em is a unit in typography, so a measure of type
the press means newspapers and journalists

explanation.surface: The tabloids take typical steps to expose a member of the royal family.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Typical' here means of type: an em is a printer's measure.
explanation.definitionFit: A female monarch ruling an empire is a royal personage.

clue.text: Takes on passengers and accelerates

definitions.meaning: to collect people in a vehicle
to gather speed

explanation.surface: A bus driver lets people board and then speeds off.
explanation.definitionFit: Collecting riders is one sense; gaining pace is the other.

clue.text: A saint is disturbed about evil

indicators.note: disturbed means thrown into disorder, so the preceding letters are jumbled

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: A holy person is troubled about wickedness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is disturbed' rearranges A SAINT to SATANI, then C is added.
explanation.definitionFit: Devilish wickedness is evil of the darkest kind, associated with the Devil.

clue.text: A drink that copper, artist and accountant love

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
CA is a chartered accountant
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A tipple enjoyed by a policeman, a painter and a bookkeeper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' looks like a policeman but is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: The orange liqueur from the Caribbean island is an alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Excellent way to keep wine air-free

definitions.meaning: British slang for splendid
stoppering a bottle keeps out the air

explanation.surface: A great method for keeping wine fresh.
explanation.definitionFit: Old British slang for splendid; literally, putting a stopper in a bottle.

clue.text: It carried warriors to the Boston Tea Party?

parts.note: cha is slang for tea
a riot is a wild party; the Boston Tea Party was itself a riot

explanation.surface: Did a vehicle bring fighters to the famous colonial protest?
explanation.walkthrough: The Boston Tea Party (1773) was a protest riot over tea, hence 'tea riot'.
explanation.definitionFit: An ancient two-wheeled war vehicle carried soldiers into battle.

clue.text: No reverse suffered by Anglicans in the past

indicators.note: a reverse sends the word no backwards

parts.note: CE is the Church of England, the Anglican church

explanation.surface: Anglicans formerly suffered no setbacks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reverse' looks like a noun for a setback but turns NO into ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Formerly, at one time, means in earlier days.

clue.text: Look hard to find a small weed

parts.note: a tare is a weed of grain fields, as in the Bible

explanation.surface: Search carefully to find a tiny weed.
explanation.definitionFit: Gazing fixedly is looking hard at something.

clue.text: Informed on fellow-criminals in Los Angeles

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the words that follow, spanning them

explanation.surface: Someone betrayed their gang in Los Angeles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in Los Angeles' seems to set the scene but holds the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang: a criminal who sings tells the police about accomplices.

clue.text: Used to be tungsten before

parts.note: W is the chemical symbol for tungsten
ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: Tungsten was once in front.
explanation.definitionFit: The past plural of 'be' expresses having existed earlier.

clue.text: Arab leader appearing in a miracle play

indicators.note: appearing in suggests showing up inside, here inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: An Arab chief has a role in a medieval religious drama.
explanation.walkthrough: A miracle play is a medieval drama about saints.
explanation.definitionFit: An emir, also spelt this way, is a Muslim ruler or commander.

clue.text: Oriental apparently heading west

definitions.meaning: belonging to the east of the world
a wind or traveller coming from the east moves westward

explanation.surface: An Asian is seemingly travelling westwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Of Asia or the Orient is one sense; coming from the east, a thing moves westward.

clue.text: Doctrine to trouble one Shiite

parts.note: an ism is a doctrine or creed
to ail is to trouble or afflict
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A belief system bothers a member of a Muslim sect.
explanation.definitionFit: Followers of the Aga Khan form a branch of Shia Islam.

clue.text: Recommended smoking requisite

parts.note: read as 'tipped' meaning advised and also fitted with a filter tip, describing a cigarette-type item

explanation.definitionFit: A filter-ended smoke is one with a tip, and to be tipped is also to be recommended.
